item.text:
Implemented `StoreGraph.loadPickupLocations.execute(postcode:)`.

Design note: follows the existing use case/repository pattern, reusing `PickupCatalog.available` for eligibility, first-eligible deduplication, and title/ID ordering. Blank postcodes fail before API access; nonblank values pass unchanged. Existing transport mapping is preserved.

Validation: all 5 tests passed, including existing-feature regression checks. `git diff --check` passed.
